description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Dark], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Chaos Incarnate Mode] to the user

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Chaos Incarnate Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, keeps track of the number of Dark abilities used (0~4), grants [Chaos Incarnate Critical Chance] after using a Dark ability
